description: Run an Apify Actor (a cloud scraping/automation program) and get its dataset results in a single blocking call. The run is capped at 300 seconds. Pass the Actor input as an `input` object — its shape depends on the Actor. Example: apify_run_actor({ actorId: "apify~web-scraper", input: { startUrls: [{ url: "https://example.com" }] }, _apiKey: "your-token" }). Browse Actors at https://apify.com/store.

_apiKey.description: Your Apify API token (get one at https://console.apify.com/sign-up, Settings → Integrations).

actorId.description: Actor identifier. Use the tilde form "username~actor-name" (e.g. "apify~web-scraper"), a "username/actor-name" form (auto-normalized to tilde), or the raw Actor ID.

input.description: The Actor input JSON. Passed as the run INPUT. Shape is Actor-specific — see the Actor page in the Apify Store. Optional; defaults to {}.

name: apify_run_actor
